# Carrier (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Carrier` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-carrier) | `GET /ref/carrier?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&CarrierID={CarrierID}&Description={Description}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-carrier) | `POST /ref/carrier` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-carrier) | `PUT /ref/carrier` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-carrier) | `DELETE /ref/carrier?ID={ID}` |


Carrier CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Carrier
| Property      | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                 |
|:--------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `CarrierID`   | Guid      |           |           | Unique Carrier ID.    |
| `Description` | String    | 256       | Yes       | Name of Carrier.      |

## Carrier

Path: `/ref/carrier`

<a id="get-ref-carrier"></a>
### GET /ref/carrier?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&CarrierID={CarrierID}&Description={Description}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `CarrierID` (optional, Guid): Only return Carrier with the specific CarrierID
- `Description` (optional, string): Only return Carriers that start with the specific Description

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 1,
  "Page": 1,
  "CarrierList": [
    {
      "CarrierID": "729cd659-c0ca-4a8a-9771-84539cd2e7e8",
      "Description": "DEFAULT Carrier"
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
    }

```
